user.title: Time settings
user.description: Night period time source and anchor times. Each configured time is an anchor: it takes effect from that moment until the next anchor.

data.sun_entity: Custom sun entity (needs next_rising / next_setting attributes)
data.trigger_time: Night starts at (used when source is fixed time)
data.end_time: Night ends / daytime starts (used when source is fixed time)
data.day_enabled: Apply daytime settings after night ends

extra_period.title: Extra period ({position})
extra_period.description: An extra period is a single anchor time: its parameters apply from the start time until the next anchor (e.g. night start).

lights_extra.title: Per-light extra settings
lights_extra.description: Enable custom parameters per light. Only enabled lights get their own settings page.

data.turn_on_listen: Apply settings when a light turns on
data.only_when_on: Only adjust lights that are already on

per_light.title: Per-light override ({position})
per_light.description: Light: `{entity}`. Fields: night, daytime (if enabled), then one brightness/color-temperature pair per extra period (extra_0 = period 1, etc.).

data.ovr_enable: Use custom parameters for this light

error.no_lights: Please select at least one light
